fields.Name: T36 - Data Explorer Search Events
fields.Description: Verifies that the Events entity grid search/filter box narrows results to events matching a term.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K global search) and go to Data Explorer, then its Data section. In the left-hand entity tree open the 'Events' entity. Wait patiently if the grid is slow to load (10-30s in this resource-constrained environment). Then use the grid's own search/filter box (within the Events grid, not the global Ctrl+K search) to search for 'Symposium'. Success is reached when the grid filters down to matching event(s), such as 'International Cheddar Symposium 2024'.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Events entity grid is open in the Data Explorer Data section
A search/filter term of 'Symposium' has been entered into the grid's search box
The grid shows at least one matching event containing 'Symposium' in its title
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
